name: submit_access_removal
description: submit_access_removal: Remove all system access for a departing employee. This is permanent and cannot be undone through the service desk.

manager_employee_id.description: The requesting manager's employee ID (e.g. EMP048271).

last_working_day.description: The employee's last working day from the off-boarding record, in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-08-29).

removal_scope.description: Scope of removal. full = all systems and groups immediately removed; staged = email and calendar preserved for 30 days for handoff, all other access removed immediately.
